{{Quote|Damn it, Krupo! I told you how precious my babies are to me, and you go and crash the ship with them in it!|Yarvok, about his pets|<ref name="Codex" />}}
'''Yug''' was the name of a [[Skar'kla]] owned by [[Yarvok]], an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Nova Blades]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. Yarvok raised Yug himself, just like he did his other two pet Skar'kla, [[Rox (Skar'kla)|Rox]] and [[Wa-Vendeg]]. [[Krupo]], Yarvok's beast wrangler, lost Yug along with several of Yarvok's other pets after a ship carrying the pets crashed on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], angering [[Yarvok]] greatly. Yarvok said he would [[Death/Legends|kill]] Krupo if his missing pets, including Yug, were not found quickly.<ref name="Codex" />

When the [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] arrived on Dantooine to investigate reports of [[Darth Malgus]] at the [[Jedi Enclave]], Yug could be seen with several of Yarvok's other lost pets, [[Fuzzy (Xuvva)|Fuzzy]] and [[Ol' Cronchy]], wandering near the Enclave's approach. Yug had a preference for [[Rishi honeystix]] found in the crash-landed shipment of cryo crates in the area.<ref name="Enclave">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Secrets of the Enclave}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Yug appeared in the flashpoint Secrets of the Enclave and was mentioned in the Codex entry for Invasive Species on Dantooine in the [[2019]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] to the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by the company [[BioWare]].<ref name="Codex" />
